name: TestGenius AI — Multi-Agent Test Generation Pipeline

nodes.name: Start Pipeline
nodes.notes: Trigger the 5-agent TestGenius AI pipeline manually or via webhook

assignments.name: source_code

nodes.name: Set Test Input
nodes.notes: Configure: source_code, framework, language, max_iterations, api_base_url

nodes.name: Health Check
nodes.notes: Verify TestGenius AI backend is online. Gates entire pipeline — fails fast if backend down.

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ source_code: $('Set Test Input').item.json.source_code, language: $('Set Test Input').item.json.language }) }}

nodes.name: Agent 1 — Analyzer (Behaviors)
nodes.notes: AST-based behavior extraction. Identifies testable behaviors from source code. Output feeds Agent 2.

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ source_code: $('Set Test Input').item.json.source_code, language: $('Set Test Input').item.json.language }) }}

nodes.name: Agent 1 — Analyzer (Complexity)
nodes.notes: Cyclomatic complexity scoring. Grades code A–D. Parallel to Behaviors + Security. Merges at Format.

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ openapi_spec: { openapi: '3.0.0', info: { title: 'Test API', version: '1.0.0' }, paths: {} } }) }}

nodes.name: Security Scanner (OWASP)
nodes.notes: OWASP Top 10: IDOR, SQL injection, mass assignment, broken auth, rate limiting. Parallel. Merges at Format.

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ source_code: $('Set Test Input').item.json.source_code, framework: $('Set Test Input').item.json.framework, language: $('Set Test Input').item.json.language, test_types: ['unit', 'integration', 'edge_case', 'security'], max_iterations: $('Set Test Input').item.json.max_iterations }) }}

nodes.name: Agent 2 — Generator (LLM)
nodes.notes: Behavior-guided LLM test generation. Triggered ONLY by Agent 1 Behaviors (not Complexity) to avoid duplicate runs.

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ test_code: $('Agent 2 — Generator (LLM)').item.json.test_code, language: $('Set Test Input').item.json.language }) }}

nodes.name: Agent 3 — Validator (Quality Score)
nodes.notes: Scores tests on 5 dimensions: assertions, edge cases, error handling, isolation, docs. Grades A–D.

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ source_code: $('Set Test Input').item.json.source_code, requirements: $('Agent 2 — Generator (LLM)').item.json.test_code, framework: $('Set Test Input').item.json.framework, language: $('Set Test Input').item.json.language }) }}

nodes.name: Agent 4 — Refiner (Mutation Testing)
nodes.notes: MuTAP-inspired: mutates source code, runs tests against mutants, identifies survivors. Reports kill ratio.

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ source_code: $('Set Test Input').item.json.source_code, test_code: $('Agent 2 — Generator (LLM)').item.json.test_code, language: $('Set Test Input').item.json.language }) }}

nodes.name: Agent 5 — Coverage Mapper (Gaps)
nodes.notes: Semantic behavior coverage gap analysis. Reports which extracted behaviors have no test coverage.

nodes.name: Format Final Result
nodes.notes: Merges all 5 agent outputs + security scan into single structured result. Triggered by Agent 5, Complexity, and Security branches.

nodes.name: Token Usage Stats
nodes.notes: Track LLM token consumption and estimated cost after pipeline completes.
